page: OVHcloud l40s-180 is a GPU-accelerated server designed for compute-heavy and graphics-intensive workloads. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 9124 processor with 30 dedicated physical cores running at 2.75 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 180 GB of system memory, providing 6.0 GB per core, and includes 400 GB of local NVMe SSD storage.

The server features two NVIDIA L40S GPUs based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, delivering a combined 96 GB of VRAM. This hardware configuration is supported by a 16 Gbps baseline network bandwidth and runs on a KVM hypervisor. The CPU supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 (VNNI and BF16) and cryptographic acceleration via AES, VAES, and SHA_NI.

Benchmark results indicate top-tier performance in LLM inference, placing in the top 10% for prompt processing and text generation across small, medium, and large models. CPU performance is strong, with stress-ng and Passmark CPU tests scoring in the top 25%. Memory bandwidth and general integer processing tasks, such as Geekbench and Redis operations, perform in the average range.

From a resource density perspective, the combination of dedicated AMD EPYC cores and dual L40S GPUs offers a highly efficient profile for machine learning workloads without the overhead of larger multi-GPU nodes. This server is optimized for LLM inference, deep learning training, data science pipelines, and high-throughput database operations.
